lines.zh: 我一节一节地蠕动，很慢。
lines.en: Segment by segment. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉爬，那里最嫩。
lines.en: I crawl the leaf veins. Tenderest part.

lines.zh: 我的脚很多，走起来像波浪。
lines.en: Many feet. My walk rolls like a wave.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶子边上，停了一下。
lines.en: I reach the leaf edge and pause.

lines.zh: 我往下够，另一片叶子在下面。
lines.en: I reach down. Another leaf below.

lines.zh: 我身上有细细的毛，别碰。
lines.en: Fine hairs on me. Don't touch.
Eating and moving forward.
On a leaf, I arch my back.

lines.zh: 我在树叶之间挪，很小心。
lines.en: Moving between leaves. Carefully.
All I need in this life is leaves.

lines.zh: 我爬过叶梗，身体压成一条线。
lines.en: Across the stem. My body flattens to a line.

lines.zh: 我抬头，找下一片能吃的叶。
lines.en: I lift my head. Next leaf, please.
I inch onto a fork in the branch.
Bark is too hard. I go around.

lines.zh: 我的身体在叶面上留了痕。
lines.en: My body leaves a track on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我往阴影里爬，太阳太晒。
lines.en: I crawl into shadow. Too much sun.

lines.zh: 叶心的汁最嫩，我慢慢啃。
lines.en: The heart of the leaf is tenderest; I gnaw slowly.
Half a leaf still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的身体一伸一缩，在呼吸。
lines.en: My body stretches and shrinks. Breathing.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子够我吃两天。
lines.en: This leaf will last two days.

lines.zh: 我不敢下地，下面没有叶。
lines.en: I don't go down. No leaves down there.

lines.zh: 树上有鸟叫，我缩成一团。
lines.en: A bird calls. I curl into a ball.
My markings are green.

lines.zh: 我安静下来，跟叶子一个色。
lines.en: Still, and I'm the color of the leaf.
Head raised. Can't see far.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子的味道有点苦。
lines.en: This leaf tastes a little bitter.

lines.zh: 我又长了一点，皮要脱了。
lines.en: I've grown. My skin is loosening.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时候安全。
lines.en: Waiting for dark. Safer then.
You're huge. Don't come near.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，你挡住了光。
lines.en: I look up. You're blocking the light.

lines.zh: 你要把我搬到别的叶子上吗？
lines.en: Are you moving me to another leaf?
I lift my front end. A sort of greeting.

lines.zh: 我的毛竖起来了，这是警告。
lines.en: My hairs bristled. That's a warning.

lines.zh: 你的手停在半空，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand stopped in the air. I saw.
Don't touch my back with a finger.

lines.zh: 我在叶子边缘，随时会掉。
lines.en: I'm at the leaf edge. Might fall.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我看不见了。
lines.en: Your shadow blinded me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头，脖子不太灵活。
lines.en: I turn slowly. My neck doesn't cooperate.

lines.zh: 我嚼着叶子，慢慢缩起来。
lines.en: I chew the leaf and curl up slowly.
A few hairs came off.
I shifted half an inch down.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我长一长就好了。
lines.en: This'll heal as I grow.
I lift myself, slowly.
I bit through a leaf vein.
I can't cry out. No voice.
Again and I fall.
My skin was due to molt anyway.
Soft body. Stops nothing.
A leaf. A fresh one.
Leaves only. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放平，我才吃得下。
lines.en: Lay it flat or I can't eat it.
The edges are a little dry.
Don't pull the leaf away. I'd fall.
Sweet bite. I'll chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我吃的时候什么也不管。
lines.en: When I eat, I notice nothing.

lines.zh: 再给一片，我就能再长一点。
lines.en: One more and I can grow.
I sniffed. Not a leaf.

lines.zh: 我吃着，眼睛还在看下一片。
lines.en: Eating, eyes already on the next one.
You touched the leaf. I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 树枝一晃，我滚到叶背下。
lines.en: The twig shakes and I roll beneath the leaf.
Don't push this branch.
The shake moved me half a leaf.

lines.zh: 碰一下，我的毛就全竖了。
lines.en: One touch and every hair stands.
I hide on the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 你的手指太粗，会压到我。
lines.en: Your fingers are too thick. You'd crush me.
A bit of fuzz came off me.
On the leaf's underside, pressing tighter.
Stop shaking it. I'll really fall.
Right now I only want this leaf.

lines.zh: 等我吐丝把自己裹起来再说。
lines.en: Talk to me when I have spun myself in.
At this stage, none of that.

lines.zh: 我们这样的，只关心叶子。
lines.en: Our sort cares about leaves.

lines.zh: 你要靠过来，我身上有毛。
lines.en: Come close. I have hairs.
Don't touch my head. Soft there.

lines.zh: 树上的毛虫不止我一只。
lines.en: I'm not the only caterpillar here.
Time to molt, not courtship.

lines.zh: 等我变成蝶，那时候再说。
lines.en: When I'm a butterfly. Then maybe.
Back off. Leaves.
I hug it with many feet.
The leaf moves. I move with it.

lines.zh: 我趴在它上面，不下来了。
lines.en: I lie on it. Not coming off.

lines.zh: 这东西不是叶子，我不要。
lines.en: Not a leaf. Don't want it.
One bite. Awful.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把它推到叶脉上。
lines.en: I nudge it toward the vein.
What you dropped landed on me.
I cling. Not daring to move.
I can bear this much.
Too smooth. I can't grip.
You touched the branch.
I raise my body and look at you.
This leaf is not for taking.

lines.zh: 你在下面，我掉下去就完了。
lines.en: You're below. If I fall, it's over.
My hairs are up already.

lines.zh: 我摆了个姿势，让你看我的颜色。
lines.en: I pose so you see my colors.
I don't bite. This is all I have.

lines.zh: 我的毛已经竖成一片刺。
lines.en: My hairs are raised into a field of spikes.
The leaf is shaking. That's me.
I crawl to the tip. Thinner there.
I raise my front end higher.
The leaf shakes. I hold still.

lines.zh: 叶子这么小，我们挤不下。
lines.en: This leaf is small. No room for two.
Don't mimic me. I'm not bluffing.

lines.zh: 我拱起背，这是最后一招。
lines.en: I arch my back. My last trick.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在叶子上不算显眼。
lines.en: My color blends with the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶面上只有一片绿，找不到我。
lines.en: Only green on the leaf; you cannot find me.
This leaf is all I have.

lines.zh: 我装成一段枯叶梗，不动。
lines.en: I play dead as a dry leaf stem.

lines.zh: 你要真抓我，我就掉下去。
lines.en: If you grab, I drop.

lines.zh: 我咬了你指头一下，很轻。
lines.en: A tiny bite on your finger.

lines.zh: 我的毛蹭到你手背，会痒。
lines.en: My hairs brushed your hand. Itchy.
My whole body flicked.

lines.zh: 我用尾端甩你，反被弹开。
lines.en: I flick you with my tail end and bounce off.
I clamp the stem and hold.
Don't shake your hand. I'd fly off.

lines.zh: 我吐了点绿的，味道很冲。
lines.en: I spat something green. Strong smell.
That bite is worth one flinch.
I curl and roll to the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 你别以为我一点力气都没有。
lines.en: Don't think I've no strength at all.

lines.zh: 我刚从卵里出来，还很软。
lines.en: I just came out of the egg, still soft.

lines.zh: 一片叶子上，多了一条毛虫。
lines.en: One more caterpillar on one more leaf.
First thing: eat.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看这个世界，很绿。
lines.en: I look up at the world. Very green.

lines.zh: 我身上还是湿的，刚孵化。
lines.en: Still damp. Just hatched.
The leaf below me is steady.
I creep to the center of the leaf.
Several of us hatched from this clutch.

lines.zh: 我先咬了一口，确认能吃。
lines.en: One bite first, to be sure.

lines.zh: 我背上寄着和平使者的种。
lines.en: A peacemaker's seed rides on my back.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身体蜷起来。
lines.en: Fire, and my body curls tight.
Hit the ground. A dull thud.
Water soaks me and I go limp.
The blast blew me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 有东西擦着我的背过去。
lines.en: Something grazed my back.
That light stiffened me.
No leaves. I'm drying out.

lines.zh: 雷声把叶子都震落了，我也掉。
lines.en: Thunder shook the leaves down. Me too.
Falling. No leaf to catch.
